annyra.name: Annyra
annyra.description: A wide, geometric luxury sans with confident round bowls. Built for logotypes, fashion labels and anything that wants to whisper expensive.

bellique.name: Bellique
bellique.description: A logo script with a steady hand. Full character set, digits and accents, plus discretionary ligatures for the letter pairs that tend to clash.

bhelmora.name: Bhelmora
bhelmora.description: A whimsical display face with bouncing baselines and soft, hand-cut curves. Complete Latin set for posters, packaging and anything that should feel handmade.

helvetica.name: Helvetica
helvetica.description: The neutral. Swiss modernism's most famous grotesk, here in seven cuts from a compressed display face to the rounded bold.
helvetica.sample: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

kavorie.name: Kavorie
kavorie.license: Demo. Personal use only, limited character set.
kavorie.description: A sharp editorial display serif with discretionary ligatures. Letters only in this demo cut.

maison-celeste.name: Maison Celeste
maison-celeste.license: Demo. Personal use only, limited character set.
maison-celeste.description: Refined fashion serif with hairline joins and long, elegant extenders. Digits and accents included in the demo.

maison-galliard.name: Maison Galliard
maison-galliard.description: A three-part brand system: a high-contrast serif, a matching sans and a script that shares their proportions. The serif and sans carry stylistic alternates and ligatures.

maroes.name: Maroes
maroes.description: A modern serif with a complete Latin character set, case-sensitive forms, ordinals and standard ligatures. The most complete text face in the library.

mofela.name: Mofela
mofela.license: Demo. Personal use only, limited character set.
mofela.description: A ligature-led display serif. Its pairs and flourishes are the whole point. Letters only in this demo cut.

raventhorn.name: Raventhorn
raventhorn.description: A decorative vintage serif with spurred terminals and a Victorian shopfront air. Ships a stylistic set and alternates for the ornamental capitals.

royal-fortune.name: Royal Fortune
royal-fortune.description: A luxury duo. A high-contrast serif and a matching script designed to sit on the same line.

royal-maison.name: Royal Maison
royal-maison.description: Serif and script companions with an old-world hotel feel. Made to pair with itself.
